summary: Final verification pass over all 10 files of the menhir 20260209 submission found only the two expected edits since the last audit (notes.md and reports/test-report.md) and no other changes. All three advisory P3s are resolved: notes.md now shows the correct OCaml native link order (`menhirLib.cmxa` before the user modules, matching test.sh and the OCaml manual) and has a single closing marker block (`**编译结束**` + `**最终状态**`), while test-report.md now describes `reports/conan-verify-report.md` as a local workspace artifact not committed to the repository (`未入仓`, raw evidence), removing the prior unsupported archive reference. All previously fixed P0/P1/P2 items remain in place: the forbidden url placeholder and its comment are gone (project-convention HTTPS URL), all homepages are https, test.sh documents its deliberate omission of set -e/pipefail for the negative-case failure-counting harness, and shutil is imported at module top level. Consistency checks still hold: the report's 13/13 consumer-test count maps 1:1 onto test.sh's 8 assert_rc calls plus 5 branch assertions and test_package/MANIFEST.yml assertion_count: 13, the 10/12 upstream-demos result and both failure reasons match MANIFEST/notes and the upstream 20260209 tree, the sha256/source URL/tool_requires are consistent across report, conandata, manifest, notes and recipe, and all 10 files are LF with trailing newline and no BOM, with no secrets/tokens, residual placeholders or http URLs. Runtime/CI claims that cannot be re-executed here (conan-verify G0-G4, local CI gates, the 13/13 and 10/12 runs, registry availability) were judged for internal consistency and truthfulness only. No P0/P1/P2 remains and no new issues were introduced, so the verdict is pass.
